publisher: data.police.uk / UK police open data service
data_date_semantics: live neighbourhood-list endpoint; no effective-date field exposed; access timestamp is the source snapshot time
identifier_semantics: Neighbourhood id is force-specific; source-area identifiers are namespaced as bedfordshire/<id>.
local_join_instruction: Do not treat these identifiers as canonical parcels. Local OpenCode must perform any parcel/coverage association.
